Shipping MAILING LIST Contact Back to site Death Master $ 139.00 1 of 2 Select option Select option TWO WEEK BUILD TIME Qty $ 139.00 Add to cart View cart The Death Master is my attempt to capture the iconic guitar sound from Celtic Frost's classic album "To Mega Therion" BLEND controls how much of the original input signal goes through the RESONANCE filter before hitting the DRIVE circuit. TONE controls mid frequencies going from scooped to boost. VOLUME is self explanatory :) This sucker totally rips! OUGH!!! SPECS: Smaller 4.7" x 2.6" x 1.5" 125B sized enclosure, true bypass switching, common 9-12vdc "CENTER NEGATIVE" 2.1mm BOSS style power input and battery snap. Current draw 9mA. Power supply not included. TESTIMONIALS: "Well..that was worth waiting over a year for.....NAILED!!!! Dude...it's fucking siiiccckkk" -Sammy Duet (GOATWHORE) "Oh dude. As soon as I plugged it in, I fell in love! Sooo good." -Andrew R. (Pennsylvania) "Amazing distortion pedal: It nails that Celtic Frost/Tommy G sound, but it's also a wonderful doom metal machine, and on low gain it's a very good overdrive too! Together synths it rips as well!!!" -Joel G. (Switzerland) "The Death Master is one of the best distortion/fuzz pedals out there. This thing does rip with thick growling type of sound. It has a lot of tone possibilities. The tone knob adjusts the mids. Sounds killer all the way down. Love this pedal just by itself and it also stacks very well with other overdrive and other distortion pedals. This is the sound I have wanted. I wasted so much money on other pedals that did not deliver this sound. It's a keeper for sure. Thanks!" -Scott (The Internet) "Wow! You nailed the Tom G. Warrior tones on the Deathmaster!!!" -Ilias I. (Seattle) "Just wanted to congratulate you on this pedal. It's a metal masterpiece, in my opinion. The blend knob is what really pushes it to the level of greatness. Will be definitely using it on my next project!" -Zachariah B.
